text:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync request — we need to align on vendor certification windows and a compatibility matrix for H200/H100, MI300, Gaudi, and B200 before the marketplace push. Can we do a short cross-org call next Tue?

kevin-hw: FYI from vendor channel — H200 tentative GA plumbing mid-Aug, MI300 mass-prod targets late Sep/early Oct, Gaudi still rolling shipments, B200 constrained but available in limited zones. Dates are soft.

ash-techops: I can pull driver/kernel compat and list required firmware/firmware-min versions. We should track rocm/CUDA parity where applicable and whether quantized runtimes are supported.

liam-sre: Also need to set CI perf windows for Dedicated pools — perf runs take ~48hrs per config. If MI300 test starts Oct 5, we need build artifacts and model weights by Oct 1.

sophie-product: Marketplace listing deadlines: catalog intake needs final assets 7 business days before public listing. That means if we want a Nov 1 public, assets due Oct 21.

ana-legal: Heads-up — for joint vendor press we require 10 business days review for legal/branding and 5 business days for security/psa. If any embargo applies, we need explicit agreement in writing.

maria-partnerships: Good notes. Let's capture concrete owners and deliverables in the thread. I propose:
- Kevin: vendor confirmed availability & firmware constraints (H200/MI300/Gaudi/B200) by Fri 9/8
- Ash: compatibility matrix (drivers, kernel, quantization support) by Mon 9/11
- Liam: CI schedule + Dedicated pool reservations by Tue 9/12
- Sophie: marketplace assets checklist and deadline confirmation by Wed 9/13
- Ana: embargo and PR timeline template by Wed 9/13

kevin-hw: Accepting. I'll attach the vendor notes doc and flag any per-region SKU delays.

ash-techops: Draft matrix (sample rows) — will fill in details.

```
component, h100, h200, mi300, gaudi, b200
driver, cuda-12.2, cuda-12.3(+)?, rocm-5.5, gaudi-driver-2.1, cuda-12.2
quantization, fp16/amp, fp16/amp, int8-support?, int8-beta, fp16
kernel, 5.10+, 6.1+, 5.15+, 5.10+, 6.1+
notes, nv-firmware-1.4, requires-firmware-1.6, vendor-image, firmware-restrict, zone-limited
```

liam-sre: Example CI window request: 48h perf, 24h stability, 8 concurrent instances max. Need quota bump for B200 on test clusters (quota request ticket created: #CI-7896).

ana-legal: Template for embargo + PR review: please fill standard fields (announcement date, embargo lift, spokespeople, allowed quotes). I can prefill legal reviewers.

maria-partnerships: Can someone create a short calendar invite for Tuesday 9/12 10:30am PT for the sync? Keep it 30min. Agenda: vendor cert status, compatibility gaps, marketplace deadlines, PR embargo windows, action items.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "HW vendor cert sync" Tue Sep 12 10:30am PT — invite sent to participants.

maria-partnerships: Perfect. One more ask — if vendors flag any region-specific SKUs (e.g., B200 only in us-west-2), call that out in the matrix so product can gate rollout regions. :eyes:

kevin-hw: Will do. I'll add a region column and a "known risk" tag.

ash-techops: I'll also note special kernel modules and a short remediation plan per gap.

sophie-product: I'll draft the marketplace asset list (screenshots, validated model ids, pricing tiers, support contact) and post it here before EOD Thu.

maria-partnerships: Thanks all — try to post deliverables in this thread so we have a single source. See you on Tue. :thumbsup:
